note: Small rustic campground with power on the south shore of the Tolna Dam reservoir, beside the highway, with a shelter, boat ramp and dock. --Claude
summary: City recreation page read: FCFS, power, free-will offering, shelter, bathrooms, boat ramp and dock. HHS licenses it to the Pekin Rod & Gun Club (10 lots). Lakefront not supported by named sites -> lakeview recommended. Pin ok.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH): recommend lakeview. No site numbers or site map exist anywhere. On imagery the camp loop sits between the highway and the reservoir's south shore. The loop's north arc (~47.8031,-98.3964) runs 10-20 m from the water over open grass and is plainly lakefront ground, but no pedestals or pads can be picked out, so no named site can be shown to be on it. The loop interior (shelter, scattered tables) runs 40-90 m back. If the reviewer accepts the loop arc as the camping line, lakefront could stay with a caveat.

OWNERSHIP: stored local, and the note called it a 'Nelson County rec area'. HHS's licence holder is the PEKIN ROD & GUN CLUB, a private club, while the City of Tolna publishes it. No county page was found. Reviewer may want ownership checked (club-run on unknown land); the note no longer names the county.
SITES: HHS licenses 10 lots; no official count published by the city. Not written (licence list only).
FACILITIES: the city says 'shelter area and bathrooms'; stored vault_toilets true (derived) is not contradicted, left.
PIN: stored 47.80295,-98.39712 is at the shelter inside the camp loop: ok.
